dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product lists its destinations in a panel at the start edge: beside the content on a large screen and over it on a compact one, narrowed to a column of icons where the content needs the width and widened again on request or with the window, grouped under headings and in groups that open and close, with the current one marked, a count or a mark at the end of some, some unavailable, and its rows as roomy as a menu's in a product used by touch as well as by pointer, or as dense as a tree view's compact rows in a tool used with a pointer whose drawer lists many places.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a navigation drawer reads, expanded and collapsed: per variant (standard: beside the content; modal: over it) the container color, elevation, shape and end-edge color; its two widths (expanded, and collapsed to the icon column), padding and the gaps of its header, and the text style and color its header slot gives what it holds; the two window widths at which a responsive drawer changes its presentation; the scrim; the section heading's style, color and height; per density (regular, compact) the geometry of a destination in each form (the expanded row, and the collapsed item container around the icon), the indent of a nested destination, the gap between cells, the collapsed column and the heading height, the trailing text and glyph, the supporting text, the guide line and the edge under pinned rows; the selection, expand and disclosure motion; and for each condition (unselected, selected, and their collapsed- forms) the colors of the item container, icon indicator, icon, label and trailing content in each state. Also, for a filterable drawer: the gap under its filter field, the status line's text style and color, the key hint's text style and color, and how a match in a label is marked (color, added weight, fill, and the two on the selected row).
rules: The selected destination is drawn from the selected parts; every other destination from the unselected parts. While the drawer is collapsed they are the collapsed-selected and collapsed-unselected parts. Never pick a look by hand.
Selected must differ from unselected by more than the icon's fill: an active indicator, a stronger color, or both.

Hover, focus and press show on the item container: the row while expanded, the box around the icon while collapsed. It is also the active indicator, and it changes color in place: it never grows in width to show a selection.

A collapsed destination is its expanded row with the label gone: the same height, the same corners, the icon at the same point. Keep collapsed.item.container.shape aliased to item.container.shape, and collapsed.item.container.width equal to the icon plus item.padding-inline on each side, unless the system's collapsed column is a different design.

A row is a menu item's size and shape: item.container.height, item.padding-inline, item.gap and item.container.shape take the values the menu's item has. A drawer destination is never a capsule in the default system.

The icon indicator is a box behind the glyph alone. The default system leaves it transparent in every condition; a layer that marks a collapsed destination behind its glyph only fills it in the collapsed conditions and clears the collapsed item container.

Every icon sits on the same point in both forms: its center is half the collapsed width from the drawer's start edge (plus the nesting indent), and its row keeps its height. Change collapsed.container.width, not a padding, to move the icon column; in the default system it is container.padding-inline, item.padding-inline and half the icon, twice.

A nested destination's content (icon and label) starts item.nest-indent further in; its item container, fill, state layer and focus indicator keep the full width of a top-level row, so that every selection has the same shape and the drawn row matches its hit area.

density is the product's choice for its drawer: regular is a menu's row, for a product used by touch as well as by pointer; compact is a tree view's compact row, for a tool used with a pointer whose drawer lists many places. Touch always gets rows of the touch target. In each density keep item.nest-indent the density's icon and item.gap (which no density changes), so that a nested destination's icon stands where its group's label starts, and collapsed.container.width the column the density's icon and paddings make.
A look that draws no item container at rest draws none when disabled.
A modal drawer is set apart by its elevation and the scrim; a standard one by its end edge.
The trailing text is quieter than the label: a regular weight in the supporting-text color.

breakpoint.expanded and breakpoint.collapsed are widths of the window, read only by a responsive drawer. They are not sizes of anything drawn, and alias the system's window classes (sys.breakpoint.expanded, sys.breakpoint.medium); set them here only to part this one component from the rest.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never fork the component.
Each condition's item.state-layer.color is the color hover, focus and press mix into its item container; it aliases the color of the content drawn on that container.

The row model is the tree view's: chevron (start, end, none), guides (none, shown, hover), indent (auto, or a number), highlight (indented, full), iconSpace (auto, always, never), expandable, one-line labels with a tooltip only where cut, supporting text below or inline, and sticky parent rows. Read the tree view's tokens' rules for what each means; the drawer's tokens carry the same names.

shape.$description: The corners at the drawer's end edge; the corners at its start edge meet the screen edge and stay square.

width.$description: The expanded drawer's width, not counting the system inset at its start. With the default padding a row is 216 wide: room for an icon, a name of some twenty characters and a short count.

padding-inline.$description: From the drawer's edges to its item containers, headings, dividers and header, in both forms. Kept small, so that a row's fill and the area that answers hover reach nearly the drawer's whole width.

padding-block.$description: Above the header (or the first cell) and below the last cell, in both forms.

gap.$description: Between two cells (a destination's or a group's), so that a selected row and a hovered neighbour stay two shapes, per density. Each cell's hit area reaches half of it above and below. Compact keeps the two shapes apart by the least room, as a dense sidebar does.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product narrows its drawer to a column of icons where the content needs the width, and sizes that column apart from the expanded drawer; one design system draws a collapsed destination as its expanded row with the label gone, another as a compact mark behind the glyph with a short label under it.

width.$description: The collapsed drawer's width, not counting the system inset at its start, per density: the icon column. Every icon's center is half of it from the start edge, in both forms. In the default system it is container.padding-inline, item.padding-inline and the icon, mirrored: 12 + 12 + 24 + 12 + 12 while regular and 12 + 8 + 16 + 8 + 12 while compact, so that a collapsed row is the expanded one cut after its icon's padding.
The collapsed item container's width, per density: in the default system the icon and item.padding-inline on each side, so that the collapsed cell is the expanded row cut after its icon's padding.

padding-inline.$description: Inside the collapsed item container, on each side of a short label, which is truncated inside it. Read only where collapsedLabels draws a label.

padding-block.$description: Above the icon indicator and below the short label (or below the icon indicator where none is drawn) inside the collapsed item container, per density; with the icon indicator it gives the expanded row's height in the default system.

shape.$description: The collapsed item container's corners, at most half its height. The expanded row's own corners: collapsing a drawer removes its labels and changes no shape.

gap.$description: From the icon indicator to the short label below it, where collapsedLabels draws one.

typescale.$description: The short label under the icon, on one line, where collapsedLabels draws one.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product puts a menu button, its own name and its main action at the top of its drawer, sets them apart from the destinations by a space of their own, tighter between the two controls than below them, and draws its name as a title of the drawer whatever element holds it.

gap.$description: From the header (its buttons, its slot and the main action) to the first cell.

item-gap.$description: Between two rows of the header: two header buttons, or a header button and the main action.

typescale.$description: The text style the header slot gives what it holds (NVD-38): the drawer's title, such as the product's name. It is inherited, so plain text placed in the slot is drawn in it, and an element of the product's that sets its own style keeps it.

color.$description: The color the header slot gives what it holds, inherited as its text style is: the content color of the drawer's surface.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product shows its drawer beside the content in a wide window, narrows it to its column in a narrower one and presents it over the content in a narrow one, and sets the two widths where that happens to suit its own content.

expanded.$description: The window width from which a responsive drawer is beside the content (the standard presentation). Below it the drawer is its column, or over the content.

collapsed.$description: The window width from which a responsive, collapsible drawer keeps its column beside the content (the column presentation). Below it nothing of the drawer is in the layout.

color.$description: The drawer's end edge.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: Material's standard drawer is set apart by tone, with no edge.
A modal drawer is set apart by its elevation and the scrim, not by an edge.

color.$description: Dims the content behind a modal drawer: the modal layer's scrim, unless a system sets the drawer apart.

blur.$description: How much the scrim behind a modal drawer blurs what lies behind it: the modal layer's (0, none, in the default system).

height.$description: A section heading's minimum height, per density; its text is centered in it. The row keeps this height while the drawer is collapsed, so the cells below it do not move.

The expanded item container's least height, per density: the destination's row, which is also its active indicator and carries hover, focus and press. Regular is a menu item's height, so that a list of places and a list of commands are rows of one size, and with the default icon it leaves item.padding-inline above and below the glyph. Compact is a tree view's compact row, for a product used with a pointer whose drawer lists many places; for touch a row is never lower than the touch target, whatever this says (NVD-6). A minimum: a row grows with a label that wraps and with enlarged text.

shape.$description: The row's corners, in both forms: a menu item's. A row that is one choice among many keeps its step of the scale and is never a capsule.

padding-inline.$description: Inside the row, per density: before the label of a destination without an icon, and after the trailing content; a menu item's. In the default system it is also the space an icon has on its start side, because the icon column is placed by it (collapsed.container.width).

padding-block.$description: Above the first line and below the last line of a row's text, per density: with one line the row is its least height whatever this says; it holds the room when the label wraps, when supporting text stands under the label, or when the text is enlarged.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product puts a second line under some of its places, or lets long names wrap, and wants those rows to keep a little room above and below their text; a dense drawer keeps less.

gap.$description: Between the icon (or the icon's kept room), the label and the trailing content of an expanded row, the same in every density: a compact drawer draws its rows lower and its glyphs smaller and keeps a name as far from its glyph as a regular one does (the tree view's icon.gap).

nest-indent.$description: How much further toward the end a nested destination's content (its icon and label) starts, per level of nesting and per density. Its item container, with its fill, state layer and focus indicator, keeps the full width of a top-level row. In both densities of the default system it is the density's icon and gap, so that a nested destination's icon stands where its group's label starts and the icons of one level stand in one column.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product nests destinations in groups and shows the depth by indenting them; another indents them less to keep long labels on one line in a narrow drawer.

size.$description: The destination's glyph, per density: the standard glyph of a row while regular, the glyph of a tree view's compact row while compact.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product marks a collapsed destination with a compact box behind its glyph alone and leaves its short label on the drawer's surface, to keep the column quiet. A layer cannot add a part the component draws, so the part is core, and the default system leaves it transparent.

width.$description: The width of the box behind the glyph alone, per density: the glyph's in the default system, which leaves the box transparent.

height.$description: The height of the box behind the glyph alone, per density: the glyph's in the default system. A cell's icon line is placed from it (NVD-31).

shape.$description: The radius of the icon indicator's four corners, at most half its height.

typescale.$description: The label's text style, per density. The default system keeps a menu item's label in both, as dense sidebars do; a system whose compact drawer sets its names smaller sets compact.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product puts a count or a short word at the end of some rows (24 unread, New), quieter than the destination's name so the names still lead the eye.

typescale.$description: The trailing count or short word: a regular weight, one step quieter than the medium-weight label.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product marks some rows with a glyph at their end — a destination that opens elsewhere, the chevron of a group — smaller than the destination's own icon so it reads as a mark, not a second destination.

size.$description: A glyph at the end of an expanded row (open_in_new, a glyph in the trailing slot) and a group's chevron, per density: smaller than the destination's icon while regular, so that it reads as a mark; the compact icon's size while compact.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product says a few words about some of its places under or after their names ("3 new", "shared with the team"), quieter than the names so that the names still lead the eye down the list.

typescale.$description: The supporting text under or after a row's label: a tree view's note, a list item's supporting text.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product marks, in each row a filter leaves or keeps, the letters that answered what was typed, as its search marks a match in a passage: how strongly — the text color, the added weight and the fill behind them — is its choice, apart from the selected fill and the state layers, and the selected row needs a fill of its own, because the quiet fill it is drawn with would hide a match drawn in that same fill.

emphasis.$description: How much weight a match gains over the row's label (NVD-85), added to the label typescale's weight.

color.$description: The text of a match on a row that is not selected (NVD-85): the stronger of the text colors. No hue: a match is not a selection, a choice or a link.

The fill behind a match on a row that is not selected (NVD-85), as well as its weight and color: the quiet tonal container, as a search's match is filled, so that a match is found in every script, also where the reader's font has no weight between regular and bold.
The text of a match on the selected row (NVD-85): the selected label's own color.
The fill behind a match on the selected row (NVD-85): the surface, cut out of the selected fill, so that the match stands apart from the row's own fill as it does on a row that is not selected.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: An unselected destination draws no active indicator; hover, focus and press mix into it.
An expanded row is marked by its item container; nothing is drawn behind its glyph.

color.$description: The active indicator: the selected row, in both forms. The role named here is the quiet selection's; the default system does not draw that tone — it values this token as a layer of the destination's own content color (selected.state-layer.color at the selected layer, sys.state.selected-state-layer-opacity: 16 %, twice the hover layer: tokens/systems/tanrei.system.json), as a list values its selected option, so that the fill is seen by the same step on whatever the surface is and stands apart from a hovered destination. A design system that sets this token draws what it sets.
On the active indicator the trailing text takes the indicator's content color; its regular weight keeps it quieter than the label.
A collapsed destination that is not selected: as an expanded one's.
The short label under the icon, where collapsedLabels draws one.
Seen only while the drawer collapses: the supporting text fades out with the expanded label.
Seen only while the drawer collapses: the trailing text fades out with the expanded label.
Seen only while the drawer collapses.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: Material 3's navigation rail, which a collapsed drawer reproduces: hover, focus and press are drawn on the indicator behind the icon (the rules).

color.$description: The active indicator of a collapsed drawer: the selected row with its label gone, in the expanded row's color.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: Material 3's navigation rail, which a collapsed drawer reproduces: it marks the current destination behind its icon, not around it.

color.$description: The short label on the collapsed active indicator, where collapsedLabels draws one.
Seen only while the drawer collapses: the supporting text fades out with the expanded label.
Seen only while the drawer collapses.
Seen only while the drawer collapses.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: Material 3's navigation rail, which a collapsed drawer reproduces: hover, focus and press are drawn on the indicator behind the icon (the rules).

state-duration.$description: How long a state change takes, and how long the item containers take to change color when the selection changes.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's).

enter-duration.$description: How long a drawer takes to slide in (and its scrim to fade in), or a standard drawer to open in the layout: the role of a sheet's entrance, so that every sheet of a product keeps one tempo.

exit-duration.$description: How long a drawer takes to slide out (and its scrim to fade out), or a standard drawer to close in the layout: the role of a sheet's exit.

selection-duration.$description: How long an icon indicator takes to grow in (and the previous one to fade out), and short labels to appear and disappear, when the selection changes. The item container does not use it: it changes color in place over state-duration.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product animates a change of the current destination at its own pace, apart from how its presses are answered and how its drawer opens.
The curve of selection-duration.

expand-duration.$description: How long the drawer takes to widen from the icon column to its full width, or to narrow back, with every part that changes on the way (the edge, the labels, the active indicator, the header).

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product widens and narrows its drawer in place, a change of the whole panel's size that it times apart from sliding a closed drawer in or out.
The curve of expand-duration.

disclosure-duration.$description: How long a group takes to open or close: its destinations revealed or hidden, the rows below moving, and its chevron turning.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product opens a group of destinations as a small local change, faster or slower than a change of the current destination or of the drawer's width.
The curve of disclosure-duration.

One product draws a line down from an open group beside what it holds, in a deep drawer where the indent alone no longer shows which rows belong together, and draws none in a shallow one; another shows the lines only while the pointer is over the drawer. The line is the drawer's own, as the tree view's is.

color.$description: The guide line of a drawer whose guides is shown, or hover while the pointer is over it or focus is in it: the one hairline. Decorative.

width.$description: The guide line's width: a hairline, in every density.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product keeps the rows of the open groups that the shown rows belong to pinned at the top of a long drawer while their items scroll under them, so that a reader deep in a long group still sees where they are; the pinned rows are set apart from what scrolls under them by an edge.

color.$description: Under a pinned row's own fill: the drawer's surface, opaque, so that the rows scrolling under the pinned rows are hidden. A modal drawer's pinned rows stand on its own container color.
The line under the last pinned row, where the rows that scroll under it begin.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product lets a person narrow a long navigation by typing in a field above it, as a documentation site's sidebar filter does: the room between the field and what it narrows, the line at the top of the results that says how many rows match or that none does, and the key hint in the empty field are its own to tune apart from the header above and from its other fields, statuses and hints.

gap.$description: Between the filter field and what stands under it: the status line, or the first item (NVD-79). The header's gap stands above the field.

typescale.$description: The line at the top of the results while a filter is applied (NVD-90): how many rows match, or that none does.

color.$description: Its color: as quiet as a section's heading, on the surface the drawer stands on.

typescale.$description: The legends of the key hint at the end of the empty field (NVD-87). The keyboard shortcut component draws no cap there.

color.$description: The legends' color: as quiet as the placeholder beside them.
